# work-plan

The work-plan sub-graph — a NAMED SUB-GRAPH of the harness, OPT-IN like `sdlc`: off in every layer unless that layer lists `cat-harness.work-plan` in its own `enableSubgraphs` (owner, 2026-11-03, rulings Q15 and Q18; cat-harness#991 step 23.2). It holds the bean Tool's skills (the `work-plan` package) and the Tool definitions of the work plan and the process engine (beans CLI, bean query, claim check, drain queue, `work_plan_prime`, the `workflow_*` tools); the graphs inside it — `work-plan-skills` and `work-plan-tools` — are declared FROM WITHIN, in `work-plan/graph.json`. Used by `sdlc` and by collaborative content development; the memory-store [Role](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#role) and its neutral tools stay in cat-harness itself, outside it (proposal §4.14).

Part of [C@T Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `work-plan`, holding `cat-harness`.
